description: The user's diary notes, three ways: note_id returns that one note in full; query searches title, body and tags and returns dated snippets; neither returns the newest notes, optionally inside a date range. These are diary entries, not training sessions (get_calendar and get_training_log have those). Searching is stemmed with a plain-text fallback, so 'pace' finds 'pacing'. Without note_id, long bodies are cut at 600 characters and marked body_truncated. Every note carries its date and date_spoken, so an answer can name the day it was written. All dates are the user's local calendar dates (YYYY-MM-DD) in their own time zone. Requires signing in.

end_date.description: Only notes on or before this local date, YYYY-MM-DD. Optional.

note_id.description: One note in full, by id. Ignores the other fields.

query.description: Topic words to look for, e.g. 'climb recce'.

start_date.description: Only notes on or after this local date, YYYY-MM-DD. Optional.

name: get_notes
title: Read the diary
